messages:
Asha K: hey @here quick Q — i'm a temporary guardian for my niece (placement 3/15). need to add her to my benefits but i'm waiting on the court guardian affidavit. carrier site says affidavit + placement letter within 30 days. payroll cutoff for new dependents is this Fri. can we get an enrollment exception if docs come after payroll?
Maya (People Ops): hi Asha — congrats and thanks for flagging. we can usually approve a temporary guardian exception up to 60 days if you submit a sworn affidavit + placement letter. need case number or judge signature. do you have an estimated upload date? :memo:
Asha K: court clerk said affidavit will be ready next tues. placement letter i already have. ssn is pending (applied with SSA). will that block enrollment?
Claire (Benefits Admin): carriers generally accept "SSN pending" plus affidavit + placement docs and a copy of your SSA application receipt. we can provisionally add dependent, but final verification requires SSN or ITIN. if SSN never arrives, we'll work with carrier to keep coverage or retro-terminate per carrier rules.
Jon (Payroll): payroll cutoff reminder: Workday submissions must be in by 11:59pm PT the day before the payroll snapshot (this Fri). if docs come after that, we can retro-enroll back to placement date if within carrier retro window (usually 60 days). any retro premiums will be reconciled on the following paycheck.
Asha K: plan: i'll upload placement letter now to Workday and upload affidavit next tues. i'll also attach SSA application receipt when available. any specific filenames or notes i should use?
Maya (People Ops): please go to Workday > Benefits > Add Dependent (QLE). upload files named: placement_letter_<last4> and guardian_affidavit_<last4>. in the notes field put "temporary guardian placement date: 2026-03-15 — SSN pending" so case reviewers have context. i'll flag for expedited review. :white_check_mark:
BenefitsBot: Reminder: file size limit 25MB. For sensitive docs you can redact in a copy and send originals to people-ops@redwood.com for secure handling.
Claire (Benefits Admin): i'll tentatively approve exception when affidavit + case number are present. @Jon — heads up for potential retro premium reconciliation.
Jon (Payroll): noted — i'll queue retro calc if needed. please tag me in the Workday case.
Asha K: uploaded placement_letter_6789. thanks everyone for the quick help :heart:
